nodes.label: Alexandra – Software de Gestión Total (partner logo)
nodes.description: Corporate logo for Alexandra, a Spanish-language software company whose tagline is 'Software de Gestión Total' (Total Management Software). The logo features a stylised red orbital/ring graphic in the upper-left corner and the wordmark 'ALEXANDRA' in bold dark-grey capitals with the letter X rendered in red. The tagline appears below in a lighter grey sans-serif font. White background. Used as a partner logo on the lanube website.
nodes.visual_style: flat corporate logo; primary palette: red (#CC0000 approx) and dark charcoal; white background; bold sans-serif wordmark
